\section*{Projects}

% PROJECT 1
\textbf{Smart Environmental Monitoring System} \,|\, Individual project \,|\, \faGithub\ \href{https://github.com/SangNguyen-232/IoT-Env-Monitor}{GitHub Repo} \hfill \textit{Jul 2026 -- Nov 2026} \\
\textbf{Stack:} ESP32-S3, C/C++, FreeRTOS, PlatformIO, TensorFlow Lite Micro, Python, JavaScript, Express, PostgreSQL
\begin{itemize}
    \item Coordinated seven FreeRTOS tasks to sample the DHT20, update the LCD and indicators, run inference, control a fan relay on GPIO10, upload telemetry and handle factory reset
    \item Integrated a 5,536-byte INT8 model that forecasts the temperature and humidity band 30 seconds ahead. It reached 87.28\% accuracy on 3,600 held-out synthetic episodes in the desktop reference interpreter
    \item Implemented fan control with configurable thresholds, early starts from the AI forecast, minimum switch intervals and automatic shutoff on stale sensor readings
    \item Built a live WebSocket dashboard on the board and an Express API that receives HTTP telemetry, stores device history in PostgreSQL and serves a central dashboard with role-based access
\end{itemize}
